mods.name: Faded Java Loader Bridge
mods.description: FJL bridge for enabled-mod Java plugin selection, restart checks, multiplayer plugin matching, and the shared FadedStack scheduler and command bus.

mods.name: Common Sense Reborn (Test)
mods.description: CSR Test 2.0.6: zombie-density and NPC feedback fixes, ClearView 0.6.19 compatibility, and a compact text-only Faded Realms Season 3 map mark. Optional hybrid 2.0.1 unchanged. Never enable with Main.

mods.name: GroundWorks
mods.description: Standalone excavation and construction with vanilla tools. Dig outdoors or beneath existing houses; preview and frame preset trenches, moats and basements. Materials and time scale with the footprint. Intact framing prevents collapse. Generate deeper floors and walls, backfill, build routes and integrate optional equipment. All gameplay works through Lua alone. Optional FJL 0.3.4+ companion for PZ 42.20.4 adds local cutaways and retains the nearby surface while underground. No ZombieBuddy or PeekAView dependency. Toggle enhanced visibility in Sandbox Options. Foreground structures, lighting and extreme depth can still affect visibility.

mods.name: Faded's ClearView UI

mods.name: Deadflow

Persistent server-authoritative population, bounded restoration, terrain-aware migration, optional iSync/Hive adapters. Requires FJL 0.3.4+; Windows and Linux dedicated. Existing Deadflow worlds supported; unimported vanilla population saves remain unsupported.

mods.name: CSR Clearview GPS
mods.description: Version 1.3.0. Standalone B42.20 Clearview GPS. Find a rare GPS tablet to open the gunmetal tablet window, plot a purple road route, autodrive, and follow live on network.fadedmods.com/map. Server-authoritative route cache in MP.

mods.name: Tactical Operations Center

mods.name: Character Creator

Replacement body animation and fitting require Faded Java Loader 0.3.4 or newer.

mods.name: Faded's Error Detected
mods.description: Build 42.20.4 diagnostics with ring-safe error capture, evidence-only attribution, a searchable ClearView-styled report interface, scalable detective alerts, persistent visibility controls, and installer update visibility. Its optional passive FJL performance profiler remains server-only and version-gated.

mods.name: BuckShot Roulette
mods.description: A lethal, server-authoritative Buckshot Roulette simulation for one survivor against the Dealer or two nearby survivors. Requires at least one loaded revolver or shotgun to open the table. Includes the complete shell game, tactical items, custom Faded UI, prizes, and a one-use curative pill for PvP winners.

mods.name: Chocobo Go
mods.description: Chocobo companions, passenger riding, Gysahl farming, breeding, color-matched 3D feathers and fitted travel gear for Project Zomboid 42.20.4. Version 0.1.2. Full features require Faded's Java Loader 0.3.4 and FadedJavaLoaderBridge.

mods.name: MP ChronoController
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 server-authoritative multiplayer Pause, Play, fast-forward voting, administrator override, sleep acceleration, safety recovery, and ClearView-style clock controls.

mods.name: ISyncYouSyncWeAllSyncForDeSync
mods.description: Background multiplayer support with adaptive Java remote-vehicle playback, merged vehicle recovery requests, and road-download priorities for PZ 42.20.4. Retains general player, zombie, and combat support. No HUD or halo text. New vehicle features require Faded Java Loader; Lua support remains available without it. SP + MP.

mods.name: SentryNet

mods.name: Faded Origins - Occupations & Traits
mods.description: Dark-edged occupations and traits with server-authoritative Resolve progression for Build 42.20.2. Integrates with SOTO and Old World Criminals.

mods.name: Faded Depths [WIP]

Java-first procedural underground dungeon and Louisville train station for Build 42.20.4 with server authority and SAFE_INSTANCE support for existing saves. Requires Faded Java Loader Bridge 0.3.4 or newer. Add FadedDepths to Mods= only; never add it to Map=.

mods.name: Vehicles by Faded
mods.description: Vehicles by Faded 1.0.2: rebakes affected vehicle skins from authored material scenes, preserving embedded textures and vertex colors lost by the FBX intermediate. Preserves vehicle scripts, physics and car-lift integration.

mods.name: Echoes of Humanity
mods.description: Persistent native survivors for PZ 42.20.4. Version 0.15.2: fixes multiplayer CSR empty-hand punch damage and repeated swapping of healthy pants in conflicting clothing slots.

mods.name: The Young Died Too
mods.description: Lightweight B42.20 adolescent zombies of varied heights, with very rare baby crawlers and shamblers that burst into pursuit. Version 1.1.0 adds a dedicated baby model, animations, and multiplayer identity sync. Schools, homes, parks and streets get age-appropriate youth among the dead. No Realism dependency. Population-neutral native IsoZombie conversions.

mods.name: Faded's The Hive

Version 2.2.1 preserves the climber, breacher, Stronghold, corridor-wander, and Chorus intel systems while repairing the vault-lunge 2D blend IDs that could terminate a dedicated server during its first zombie initialization. The optional Java accelerator remains optional; Echoes of Humanity and My Only Friend are optional peers.

mods.name: Water Expanded
mods.description: The comprehensive Build 42 water, plumbing, irrigation and fuel-network overhaul. One server-authoritative WEX graph connects pumps, valves, meters, seep channels, building-wide liquid plumbing, storage, fixtures, gas stations and generators without a bridge hub. Includes calibrated rain collectors, liquid-effect details, mains reconnection, physical petrol routing, portable pumping, quick view, public physical-container API, optional Faded Java Loader acceleration and command routing, and a complete standalone native fallback.

mods.name: Solar Never Faded

mods.name: Temp Control

mods.name: Faded Skies
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 helicopter flight, utility, and combat systems. Includes the FS UH-1B Iroquois utility helicopter and FS AH-64A attack helicopter. Designed for single-player, hosted multiplayer, and dedicated servers with server-authoritative weapons and noise.

mods.name: RVsReborn

mods.name: Faded Locomotion

Version 1.0.0 repairs consist rendering, coupler spacing, turn alignment, carrier scale, force-position synchronization, and first-notch braking, with an optional Faded Java Loader carrier-pinning bridge and a complete pure-Lua fallback.

mods.name: On The Move
mods.description: Quiet human-powered mobility for Build 42.20: bicycles, skateboards, scooters, and rollerblades with rare sensible spawns, crafting, repairs, terrain response, riding exertion, and multiplayer animation synchronization.

mods.name: Project Faded Car

Version 0.3.0 adds earth scooping, direct truck transfers, corpse collection, interchangeable crane tools, house demolition, visible tipper loads and dumpster fill.

mods.description: Faded Farms Forever 0.4.1-b42.20.4: correct outer-cart weight-reduction setter; preserves high reductions and saved-cart restamping.

mods.name: Parent's Journal
mods.description: A keepsake from home. Every survivor starts with Dad's Journal or Mom's Journal. Use it once to answer a few questions about your parent and receive bonus skill experience and personality traits based on your choices. The journal is consumed after you submit your answers.

mods.name: Salvaged Fuel Recovery Station
mods.description: Commission a fixed industrial generator and nearby tanks or barrels to manufacture and store gasoline or propane. Gasoline requires a hose and compatible container to recover; propane requires an empty propane tank.

mods.name: My Only Friend
mods.description: Server-authoritative dog and cat companions with 56 expanded visual variants, training, working orders, combat, rosters, wildlife ecology, persistence, and recovery. Version 2.3.6 keeps wildlife enabled while reducing new wolf grounds to five with 500-tile spacing, safely retires surplus or clustered wild grounds and stale markers, and never retires owned companions. Optional FJL adds engine AI control and bounded acceleration.

mods.name: Never Survive Alone

Version 0.7.0-alpha adds optional Echoes 0.5.0 NPC partner shared rest with persistent identity, native safety/completion checks, saved partner Afterglow and a compact shelter/pair radial icon. Retains existing player scenes, wardrobe, lifestyle/item integrations and CSR Survivor Bond support.

mods.name: Faded's Hunters Calling
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42.20.2-42.20.4 hunting system with a responsive three-pane fieldbook, wild boar sounders, game feeders, a hunting tripod, wind-aware scent, a charcoal smokehouse and game cellar, five .308 rifles, four bows, native Crafting and Building tabs, tracking with an optional Java accelerator and complete Lua fallback, field dressing, preservation, calls, scents, trapping, and multiplayer-safe administration. Includes CraftBench leather/plant racks and a kiln rack for dedicated MP, where vanilla drying racks do not finish.

mods.name: The Price We Pay

mods.name: Skill Book Expansion
mods.description: Adds the missing Build 42.20.2 skill books and book sets for Axe, Long Blunt, Short Blunt, Short Blade, Spear, Nimble, Sprinting, Sneaking, Lightfooted, Fitness, and Strength.

mods.name: Faded's Lifestyle: Hobbies (All-in-One B42.20)
mods.description: Faded's Lifestyle: Hobbies Original author: Angry | Faded rebuild: Faded A Build 42.20 all-in-one Lifestyle rebuild with custom Faded ClearView presentation and targeted performance hardening. Highlights: - Discover hobbies that pass time and improve morale. - Play instruments, learn songs, sing, and form a band. - Dance around functional jukeboxes, DJ booths, and disco equipment. - Develop art, yoga, cleanliness, invention, beauty, and ambition systems. - Uses original Faded survivor illustrations, semantic pictograms, and charcoal ClearView interfaces with restrained violet accents. - Replaces recurring world scans and high-frequency inventory refreshes with event-driven, bounded work. Keep a little humanity in the apocalypse. Has sandbox options. Compatible with most other mods, except mods that reduce timed-action duration.

mods.name: It's A Trap!
mods.description: Build 42.20.4+. Server-authoritative traps, defenses, explosive barrels, spanning tripwires, cook-off ammo, cages, and reactive hazards. Version 2.1.2 fixes multiplayer world loading by replacing invalid tiledef IDs 8190-8192 with valid, collision-audited IDs 8111-8113.

mods.name: The Path Less Traveled
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 native Skills-tab progression from level 10 to 15 with ClearView-style mastery cells and server-authoritative permanent category buffs.

mods.name: Faded Beds Have Blankets
mods.description: Period-correct removable blankets, larger pillows, sleep warmth, and restful covered-bed sleep for Build 42.20.

mods.name: What A World
mods.description: Consent-first performance advice for Build 42.20.4, plus an integrated climate suite and a world that behaves like one. What A World observes frame pacing and may suggest Boosted, Standard, Potato, or a vanilla Display-settings review, but never changes display settings, visual quality, UI drawing, texture quality, or a profile automatically. Players review and explicitly accept or dismiss suggestions in the F7 panel. Air temperature depends where you stand. Thunderstorms become authored Black or Dread storms with closing visibility, authored lightning, grid failure and location-aware atmosphere. Acid rain arrives behind a green warning fog and eats clothing, skin and the dead. Twenty-one donor systems are imported and integrated rather than merely governed: visible sky-to-ground lightning synchronised to the engine's own strike, livestock that react to thunder, weather exposure, restorative deep forest, native room occlusion with player-built rooms, cockroach and cicada ambience, a one-per-save aircraft crash that happens hundreds of tiles away and waits to be found, a full ground-cover overhaul, dirt roads kept clear of erosion growth, doors that visibly break in three stages across 61 door families, torchlight that falls through floor openings onto the storey below, flashlights recalibrated from real photometry, a pack that creaks with what you are carrying, working cinema popcorn machines, body bags, a hospital gurney that carries five corpses at once, and pigs, raccoons, rats, mice and chickens that feed on the dead and leave a skeleton with its loot still on it. Every imported system is metered by the same per-player budget table, so a weak machine gets fewer of them rather than a broken world, and every donor defect found on the way in was fixed rather than carried along. Includes server-authoritative weather events and damage, craftable weather stations, battery-powered receivers, recorded station history, and full sandbox tuning. Optional Faded's Java Loader support adds safe load concurrency, exterior occlusion and a pixel framebuffer that powers playable retro consoles, all off until explicitly enabled. The optional What A World - Solar Shadows companion adds projected sunlight and mesh shadows; the tier drives its shadow budget when both are installed.

mods.name: The Big Tree Fix
mods.description: Fixes Build 42.20+ jumbo tree visibility indoors, while driving, and on foot. Registered fade canopies are save-loadable, and default-on infrastructure filtering downsizes selected XL/XXL trees near roads and buildings while preserving giant trees in dense forests. Fade textures based on work by movinow.

mods.name: What A World - Tree Visibility
mods.description: Optional TreeZ-derived companion shaders that keep foliage from hiding what is behind it. Published separately so servers and players can opt in deliberately.

Deadflow owns population when it is present. Character Creator, Common Sense Reborn, Faded's ClearView UI and Faded Java Loader are used when present and are not required.
